Allegri furious at draw; Gasperini sees goal-scoring as positive signal

Yahoo Sports reported that Allegri was enraged after the 3-3 draw, stating, 'Maybe I shouldn't be on the touchline,' while also noting Roma's comeback. ESPN Singapore's Burley questioned whether Manchester United were good or Roma were bad in the match. Conversely, Gasperini, Roma's coach, indicated that scoring many goals was a 'good signal' and that the team felt like they had dropped two points in the Napoli draw.
